verdict.rationale: Official repo docs show GitHub-native triggering: you can mention @gemini-cli in issues and pull requests to delegate tasks, and it runs automated PR reviews and issue triage. Community comments reference the GitHub action and praise its code review. There is no evidence of launching tasks from GitLab, Linear, or Slack, so only one of the four named surfaces is covered. Missing for 10: GitLab integration, Linear integration, Slack integration, and in-depth docs on how GitHub-triggered delegation is set up and runs.
